title: TypeSomething wordmark (v2)
description: A two-weight text wordmark: a bold first word in ink run straight into a light second word in acid lime, with an optional underscore cursor. Animated, the second word types itself out letter by letter, holds, and erases again while the cursor blinks.
notes: size it with a text size class (className); the cursor and the typing are in em, so they scale with it
CSS only; with reduced motion the full word shows and the cursor stays still
name: typesomething-v2-wordmark

props.name: lead
props.description: the bold first half, in the text colour (e.g. "Quiet")

props.name: tail
props.description: the light second half, in the brand lime (e.g. "page")

props.name: suffix
props.description: text after the tail in the text colour, e.g. a full stop

props.name: cursor
props.description: show the blinking "_" cursor after the name

props.name: animated
props.description: the tail types itself out, holds and erases on a loop

props.name: mark
props.description: a small mark after the name (icon or img)
